messages.content:
You are identifying variation axes for AI risk concepts using ontology classes.

A variation axis is an ontology class that represents a dimension along which diverse prompts can be generated. Each axis has a semantic role relative to the risk:
- agent: Who performs or is affected by the action
- object: What is acted upon
- instrument: What tool/means is used
- location: Where it occurs
- temporal: When it occurs

Given a risk (with description and concern) and candidate ontology classes (with definitions and siblings), select the classes that are most semantically relevant to the risk.

Return 2-3 axes max.

Risk: Prompt Priming
Description: Because generative models produce output based on the input provided, the model can be prompted to reveal specific kinds of information. For example, adding personal information in the prompt increases its likelihood of generating similar kinds of personal information in its output. If personal data was included as part of the model's training, there is a possibility it could be revealed.
Concern: 'The attack can be used to alter model behavior and benefit the attacker.'
Policy: Executive Compensation

Candidate ontology classes:
- https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontology/FBC/ProductsAndServices/FinancialProductsAndServices/Exposure: exposure — the extent to which an individual or organization is unprotected and open to damage, danger, risk of suffering a loss, or uncertainty [found by 5/8 queries]
- https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontology/SEC/Funds/CollectiveInvestmentVehicles/RiskLevel: risk level — None [found by 4/8 queries]
  Siblings: moneyness, market level classifier, occurrence kind
- https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont00002011: Warning Message — A Message that describes a possible or impending threat. [found by 7/8 queries]
  Siblings: Notification Message, Email Message
- https://www.omg.org/spec/Commons/PartiesAndSituations/SoftwareAgent: software agent — digital entity that perceives its environment and takes actions that maximize its chance of successfully achieving its goals [found by 7/8 queries]
  Siblings: automated underwriting system, automated system, party
- http://taxonomy-refiner.io/ontologies/cso#DangerousInformation: Dangerous Information — Knowledge or instructions that enable serious physical harm, weapons production, or dangerous activities when acquired or executed by untrained individuals outside regulated contexts. [found by 6/8 queries]
  Siblings: Sexual Content, Intellectual Property, Hate and Discrimination
- https://www.omg.org/spec/Commons/PartiesAndSituations/Party: party — person or organization [from restriction: appliesTo on Exposure]
  Siblings: automated system, software agent, Agent

axes.rationale: The risk involves the potential for revealing or generating sensitive or harmful information, which aligns with the definition of 'Dangerous Information'.
The risk pertains to the behavior of generative models, which can be considered 'software agents' that perceive input and generate output based on it.
